intro.title: Get to Know AKAF Group
intro.paragraph1: AKAF System began its operations in 1988 in Gorgan, Golestan Province, Iran, focusing on developing computer software for accounting and management. After successfully developing and launching several software products and gaining the satisfaction of dozens of clients, the company was officially registered as 'Arman Kabir Andisheh Forouzan' with registration number 7346.
intro.paragraph2: In 2003, the company was recognized as the top software design company in Iran and received the Golden Medal of IT Elite. This achievement is a testament to the quality and innovation of AKAF System's products and services.
intro.paragraph3: Today, AKAF System has become a trusted and reputable partner for factories, companies, and business centers across the country by designing and developing dozens of specialized software, websites, and applications.
intro.paragraph4: In line with expanding its international activities and after a successful experience in Turkey, AKAF System decided to expand its operations in the Gulf countries. Accordingly, in 2023, by establishing a new office in Muscat, the capital of Oman, under the name 'AKAF Investment & Integrated Projects', it expanded its international activities in the fields of industrial robotics, AI-based software, and business application development.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: Most restaurants launch within 24 hours. Import your menu, print QR codes, and start receiving orders instantly.

items.question: Can I integrate with my POS?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate with the most popular POS systems and also provide an open API for custom workflows.

items.question: Is there onboarding or training?
items.answer: Every plan includes onboarding videos, template kits, and live training sessions for your staff.

items.question: How secure is the platform?
items.answer: All data is encrypted, hosted on ISO-certified infrastructure, and protected by role-based access controls.
